arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo VPS_PASSIVE_SUPERVISOR_PROBE
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from os.path import basename
import os
matches=[]
unreadable=0
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdecimal(): continue
 try:
  data=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
  argv=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in data if x]
  if not argv:continue
  command=basename(argv[0]).lower()
  if command in {'bash','sh','dash','timeout','sudo','grep','git'}:continue
  if not any(term in command for term in ('python','node','pm2','supervisor','telegram')): continue
  arg_head=argv[1:4]
  types=[name for name in ('supervisor_live.py','supervisor_cloud_source.py','telegram_gateway.py','supervisor_passive.py','passive_supervisor.py') if any(name in x for x in arg_head)]
  if types:matches.append({'pid':p.name,'program':command,'script':','.join(types)})
 except (OSError,PermissionError):unreadable+=1
for row in matches:
 print('RESIDENT_MATCH program=%s script=%s pid=%s'%(row['program'],row['script'],row['pid']))
print('RESIDENT_MATCH_COUNT=%d'%len(matches))
print('UNREADABLE_PROCESSES=%d'%unreadable)
PY
echo VPS_SUPERVISOR_UNITS
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|project-leader|codex|telegram' | cut -c 1-150 || :
echo VPS_SUPERVISOR_TIMERS
systemctl list-unit-files --type=timer --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|project-leader|codex|telegram' | cut -c 1-150 || :
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-supervisor-inspect.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/vps"
cd "$tmp/vps"
echo SUPERVISOR_CODE_FILES
find ops -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*supervisor*' -print | sort | head -n 35
echo SUPERVISOR_WORKFLOW_REFERENCES
grep -R -n -E 'supervisor_cloud_source|supervisor_live|telegram_gateway|SUPERVISOR_CLOUD|passive.supervisor' .github/workflows 2>/dev/null | head -n 80 || :
echo SUPERVISOR_SOURCE_ENTRYPOINTS
for f in ops/supervisor_live.py ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py ops/telegram_gateway.py; do
 if test -f "$f"; then
  echo "FILE=$f"
  grep -n -E '^if __name__|^def main|^async def main|^def run|^def (notify|observe)|^class |^    def (poll|run)' "$f" | head -n 25 || :
 fi
done
echo REA_SUPERVISOR_PROBE_DONE
